create_timestamp_from_json_string: create a protobuf Timestamp from an RFC 3339 date string like 1972-01-01T10:00:20.021-05:00
create_timestamp_from_current_time: create a protobuf Timestamp from the current UTC time using datetime
convert_timestamp_to_json_string: convert a protobuf Timestamp to an RFC 3339 Z-normalized date string with fractional digits
convert_timestamp_to_datetime: convert a protobuf Timestamp to a Python datetime object with optional timezone info
convert_timestamp_to_microseconds: convert a protobuf Timestamp to microseconds since epoch as an integer value
